artifact_groups.rationale: Heavy compute solo map: 3D creatures evolve through selection pressure. Genetic programming as dramatic opener — evolution without explicit design.
Heavy compute solo map: trees grow toward attractors via space colonization. Branching structure emerges from point-cloud competition — growth without blueprint.
Heavy compute solo map: percolation network CA tests connectivity thresholds in random grids. Dark sphere anchors the visual field as clusters form or fragment at the critical probability.
Two growth strategies compared: branching algorithm builds tree-like structures toward attractors, organic noise space sculpts terrain from Perlin fields. Medium compute, safe to pair.
Procedural exploration spaces: cave random walk carves tunnels through solid rock, maze generation builds corridors from recursive backtracking. Two strategies for explorable worlds.
Geometric construction: cube mound accumulates voxels, dome subdivides icosahedra, layered membrane stacks transparent surfaces. Three ways rules sculpt form from accumulation.
Pattern from reflection and branching: mirrored cellular texture wraps CA output symmetrically onto 3D form, rhizomatic maze builds non-hierarchical branching networks. Light compute synthesis.
New catalyst affordance demo for the proceduralgeneration phase: seed_orb.
